interpretation_rule: The encoders are frozen. A document vector never moves. The only dynamical object is corpus-induced relational structure (neighbor identity/rank, hubness-corrected neighbor identity, and region-level churn). Static alignment is inherited context, not selected from these outcomes.
dbnorm_note: DBNorm is not a primary control here because its published setting uses distinct query and gallery banks in cross-modal retrieval. Treating one symmetric corpus as both banks would be an unvalidated method adaptation. CSLS and exact empirical Mutual Proximity provide two established, structurally appropriate hubness-control families.
claim_boundary: Frozen encoders only. Coordinates never move; only corpus-induced relational structure is replayed. The stationary/exchangeable insertion null is the primary falsifier. No generator, labels, or policy are used.
